title: hello.food household context on channel evaluation results
description: The ADDITIVE household-context shapes the channel evaluation tools (evaluate_menu, describe_dietary_graph, suggest_recipes, log_meal) return once Phase 2.1(i) routed them through HouseholdContextResolver. Every field declared here is new; every pre-existing field keeps its shape and, for a single-member account, its exact value. A client that ignores this contract renders exactly what it rendered before.

scope_resolution.default: An account with synced household members is evaluated HOUSEHOLD-WIDE. An account with only the owner resolves to the owner alone.

explicit_values._self: The account owner only, even when the account has synced members.
explicit_values.everyone: Every synced member. Resolves to the owner alone for a household of one — not an error.
explicit_values.<member id>: That member's own restriction set drives a single-profile evaluation, symmetric with _self.

scope_resolution.never_inferred: Safety scope is explicit-or-default. It is NEVER derived from how a request was phrased in natural language.

errors.422: Malformed scope (not _self, not everyone, not a member id), or a scope that requires an authenticated account when there is none. Channel error code: invalid_household_scope.
errors.404: A well-formed member id that is not a synced member of THIS account. Channel error code: household_scope_not_found.

household_block.presence: Present on every result these four tools return; absent only on results produced before this contract shipped.

fields.effective_scope: "_self" | "everyone" | member id — the scope that was actually resolved.
fields.members: Stable-ID member refs projected from the snapshot: member_id, profile_version (never fabricated — null for request-first/ephemeral contexts), profile_source (persisted|request|ephemeral). Carries NO display name.
fields.member_count: Number of members in the resolved scope.
fields.consent_state: granted | revoked | not_applicable — the consent state under which the context was assembled.
fields.context_hash: Deterministic fingerprint of the resolved household context. A stored result whose context_hash no longer matches was produced under a household context that has since changed.
fields.context_hash_version: Travels beside any persisted hash so a serialization change can never silently invalidate or falsely match a stored result.

member_annotation.cardinality: One entry per member in the resolved scope, per evaluated item.

disposition.flag: INFORMATIONAL. The item stays in the result; the annotation explains what it means for that member. Every annotation these four tools emit is a flag.
disposition.excluded: Reserved for the recommendation-integrity contract (2.3): the item was REMOVED from that member's recommendations because it conflicts with an ALLERGEN-class restriction, and is accounted for explicitly. Carries allergen and reason (including "uncertain" when allergen data is missing — when uncertain, avoid). Non-allergen restrictions never exclude.
disposition.shared_contract: The two directives share ONE annotation type. A renderer branches on disposition, not on which tool produced the annotation.

fields.member_id: Stable id. "_self" is the account owner (NOT a UUID). Annotations key on this, never on label.
fields.label: Display label when the household assembly surfaced one. Presentation only — never an identity.
fields.disposition: flag | excluded — see member_annotation.disposition. Always "flag" from these four tools.
fields.allergen: Allergen that drove an exclusion (2.3). Null for flags.
fields.reason: Why the disposition was applied (2.3). Null for flags.
fields.model_version: C2: the concrete producer of this verdict. "unrecorded" when the evaluation did not run — never a fabricated model.
fields.rules_version: C2: the deterministic rules layer version.
fields.context_hash: C1: the snapshot this annotation was produced under. Equal to household.context_hash.
fields.member_profile_version: The member's persisted profile version, or null when no persisted version exists.

aggregation.rule: An item's headline fields (status, confidence, summary, conflicts) are the household AGGREGATE: the annotation with the WORST safety status wins; ties break to the least confident reading; remaining ties keep household order.
aggregation.unknown_handling: unable_to_evaluate outranks risky (an unknown is at least as serious as a known caution) but is NEVER promoted to avoid, which would assert a verdict that was never produced.
aggregation.single_member_identity: For a single-member scope the aggregate is trivially that member's own annotation, which is why a solo account's headline fields are unchanged.

evaluate_menu.note: Each item is evaluated once per member in scope. Identical (dish, member) pairs are evaluated once per call.

describe_dietary_graph.note: summary describes the resolved scope; restriction_count / preference_count / avoid_ingredient_count are the DISTINCT UNION across the members in scope; meal_count_7d and rating_count cover those members.

suggest_recipes.note: For a household the recipe is optimized against the UNION of the scope's restrictions, preferences and avoided ingredients. match_hint is a tag-level compatibility hint and is NOT authoritative — safety_summary remains the verdict.

log_meal.note: ATTRIBUTION ONLY — scope decides who the meal is filed against and changes no evaluation semantics. Precedence: an explicit member scope (validated against the account), then the client-asserted active_member_id, then the account owner. A household-wide scope files against the owner, because a meal is eaten by one person.

compatibility.single_member_guarantee: For an account with no synced members, every pre-existing field of all four results is byte-identical to the pre-2.1(i) output. Pinned by tests/test_channel_household_evaluation.py.
compatibility.unknown_field_policy: Clients must ignore unrecognized fields inside household and member_annotation objects; 2.3 extends member_annotation without a version bump.

amendments.change: New contract. Declares the household block, the per-member annotation shape (including the flag/excluded disposition shared with the recommendation-integrity contract), the worst-case aggregation rule, and the explicit household_scope argument plus its 422/404 semantics, for evaluate_menu, describe_dietary_graph, suggest_recipes and log_meal. New fixture fixtures/household_evaluation/founding_scenario_maya_menu.json.
amendments.reason: The four channel evaluation tools hardcoded member_id="_self" and handed a household user solo verdicts while grocery screened household-wide — one product, two safety promises (capability audit gap 9). They now consume the same HouseholdContextSnapshot every other household-aware surface consumes.
amendments.compatibility: Purely additive. No pre-existing field changed shape; a single-member account's values are unchanged byte-for-byte. household_scope is optional and defaults to the resolver's default resolution. No REST endpoint, confirmation envelope, capability or scope changed.
amendments.attestation_status: Describes THIS tree. No deployment evidence is recorded yet; a deployment record is required after this change ships.
